title: Charge Waiver Standard for the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Charge Waiver Standard — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Standard.** Under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, a charge may be waived only once. A courtesy waiver (reason: courtesy annual) applies only to a late charge and only while the courtesy waivers already granted in the current calendar year on any unit of the same master agreement are below the tier's courtesy late-charge waivers per year. A servicing-error waiver applies to any charge the company's records show it caused. Waivers are always of the whole charge, and remarketing, recovery and deficiency charges are never courtesy-waived.

## Elements

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Once only | a charge that already carries a waiver is not waived again; this is read from the waivers posted against that charge |
| Courtesy waiver — what | a late charge only |
| Courtesy waiver — how many | only while this calendar year's courtesy waivers on the master agreement, counted across all its units, are below the tier's allowance |
| Servicing-error waiver — what | any charge the company's records show it caused |
| Extent | always the whole charge |
| Never courtesy-waived | remarketing, recovery and deficiency charges |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A master agreement in a tier allowing one courtesy waiver a year has had no courtesy waiver this calendar year. A late charge on one of its units may be courtesy-waived; afterwards the year's count equals the allowance, and a second late charge on another unit of the same master agreement may not be courtesy-waived that year.
2. A master agreement in a tier whose allowance is zero cannot receive a courtesy waiver at all, because a count of zero is not below zero.
3. A recovery fee is never courtesy-waived. It may be waived for servicing error only if the company's records show the company caused it.
4. A late charge that was waived once cannot be waived a second time, for any reason.
